data.standardized_narrative: Gross claims reserves at the start of 2020 were $609.34m (gross claims outstanding at 31 Dec 2019). The syndicate's gross prior-year reserve estimates were essentially stable during 2020 (no material gross prior-year strengthening or release was identified from the gross claims development table). Narrative disclosure notes and year-of-account commentary reference net favourable development on prior years, but that relates to net (after reinsurance) outcomes rather than a change in gross claims estimates. Major 2020 catastrophe losses (Laura, Sally, Midwest Derecho, western US wildfires) and COVID-19 affected the 2020 calendar result but did not materially change the gross prior-year claim estimates.

data.data_quality_notes: Gross prior-year development was calculated from the gross claims development (triangle) which shows no material change for underwriting years 2018 and earlier (gross PYD = $0.0m). Narrative and year-of-account commentary refer to net favourable development (e.g. a $10.7m profit on development of 2017 and prior and overall earned profit of $21.7m for 2019 and prior), which are net-of-reinsurance outcomes. Where only net figures are quoted in narrative, this has been noted but not used for the gross PYD (per instructions). RITC activity (split RITC of 2018 into Syndicate 1994 / 2019) occurred and can distort year-of-account comparisons; the gross triangle was used as the authoritative gross source.
